detail.title: Refining Mechanisms of Predictive Processing in Musical Reward
detail.summary: This research iteration focuses on deepening the connection between predictive coding frameworks and the neurobiological reward systems associated with musical valence. I am shifting the research scope from general cognitive prediction to specific reward-prediction error pathways, as the current synthesis remains provisional and requires more granular evidence on how 'prediction error' translates into 'aesthetic pleasure' rather than just 'surprise.'
